stories.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs Shed $530 Million as Broader Market Selloff Hits Crypto
stories.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs lost a combined $530 million in one day. The outflow came alongside a wider selloff that erased about $3 trillion from Wall Street. CryptoSlate ties the ETF outflows to that broader market stress, not to a crypto-specific trigger.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows show institutional demand for crypto. A sharp one-day reversal shows crypto still trades like a risk asset tied to broader markets.
whatToWatch: Next ETF flow reports, to see if outflows continue
Whether the broader equity selloff stabilizes
questions: Were the outflows concentrated in a few large funds?
Is this a one-day event or the start of a longer trend?

sources.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs lose $530 million in one day as $3 trillion Wall Street wipeout rattles crypto

stories.title: Bitcoin's Rate-Cut Rally Stalls as Service Inflation Picks Up
stories.summary: Bitcoin's recent gains, driven by hopes for a rate cut, have stalled. New data shows a pickup in service-sector inflation. CryptoSlate reports this has clouded the rate-cut outlook and weighed on bitcoin's momentum.
stories.whyItMatters: Rate expectations drive money into risk assets like bitcoin. A shift in the inflation picture can reverse recent price gains.
whatToWatch: Upcoming inflation reports
Signals from policymakers on rate-cut timing
questions: How much of bitcoin's recent rally was priced on a rate cut alone?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s rate cut relief stalls as service inflation flares

stories.title: Bug in Unpatched Bitcoin Lightning Nodes Could Drain Payment Channels
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports a bug in unpatched Bitcoin Lightning Network nodes. The bug could let an attacker drain funds from open payment channels. Node operators who have not applied a fix remain exposed.
stories.whyItMatters: The Lightning Network handles a large share of bitcoin payments. A channel-draining bug puts funds in unpatched nodes at risk.
whatToWatch: Whether node operators patch quickly
Any reports of the bug being exploited
Further detail from Lightning implementation teams
questions: How many nodes remain unpatched right now?
Has the bug been exploited in the wild?

sources.title: Unpatched Bitcoin Lightning nodes face channel-draining bug

stories.title: Solana Developers Propose Overhaul to Fix Hidden Network Risk
stories.summary: Solana developers have proposed a major overhaul of the network. The goal is to address a hidden risk that could disrupt Solana, according to CryptoSlate. The report does not give full detail on the risk or the proposal's specifics.
stories.whyItMatters: Changes to Solana's core design affect how reliable the network is for anyone holding or building on it.
whatToWatch: Community and validator response to the proposal
A formal vote or rollout timeline
questions: What exactly is the hidden risk?
How soon could the overhaul ship?

sources.title: Solana developers propose major overhaul to address hidden risk that could disrupt its network

stories.title: XRP Sellers Hit by Heavy Slippage as Order Book Depth Misleads
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that XRP sellers are facing unusually large slippage. The USD order book's displayed depth does not match the liquidity actually available. Large sell orders are moving the price more than the order book would suggest.
stories.whyItMatters: Misleading liquidity makes XRP more volatile to trade and raises doubts about how reliable its listed order books are.
whatToWatch: Whether exchanges address the order book discrepancy
XRP price swings on large sell orders
questions: Which trading venues show the biggest gap between displayed and real depth?

sources.title: XRP sellers face massive slip as USD order book depth fakes size

stories.title: Gate Reports 104% Cold Reserve Coverage, but Mismatched Snapshot Dates Raise Doubts
stories.summary: Exchange Gate reported cold reserve coverage of 104%, according to CryptoSlate. The proof-of-reserves used separate snapshot dates for assets and liabilities. The report says this timing gap undercuts confidence in the figure.
stories.whyItMatters: Proof-of-reserves is one of the few checks users have on exchange solvency. Mismatched snapshot timing weakens that assurance.
whatToWatch: Whether Gate issues a reserve report with matched snapshot dates
Reaction from auditors or users
questions: Why were the snapshot dates not aligned?
Does the timing gap change the real coverage ratio?

sources.title: Gate boasts 104% cold reserve coverage, but separate snapshot dates raise red flags

stories.title: Bitcoin's $2.7 Billion Friday Options Expiry Carries a Five-Hour Blind Spot
stories.summary: Bitcoin traders face a $2.7 billion options expiry on Friday, CryptoSlate reports. The report flags a five-hour window around the expiry with limited market visibility. That gap adds risk for traders positioned around the event.
stories.whyItMatters: Large options expiries can move bitcoin's price sharply, and a known visibility gap raises the odds of a surprise move.
whatToWatch: Friday's expiry and the resulting price action
Unusual volatility during the flagged five-hour window
questions: What causes the five-hour blind spot?
Have past expiries this size moved the price significantly?

sources.title: Bitcoin traders face Friday’s $2.7 billion options expiry with a dangerous five-hour blind spot

stories.title: Optimism Proposal Would Curb Council's Power Over Standalone Chains
stories.summary: A new proposal in the Optimism ecosystem would reduce the governing council's authority over standalone chains, CryptoSlate reports. The change would shift some control away from central oversight toward the chains themselves.
stories.whyItMatters: Council power over connected chains affects decentralization and independence for projects built on Optimism's stack.
whatToWatch: A governance vote on the proposal
Response from standalone chain operators
questions: Which standalone chains would be most affected?

sources.title: Optimism new proposal weakens council power over standalone chains

stories.title: Treasury's $6 Billion Bond Buyback Draws Skepticism From Dealers
stories.summary: The US Treasury bought back $6 billion in bonds. CryptoSlate reports that bond dealers say the operation is not large enough to ease the underlying market strain. The buyback is part of efforts to support bond market liquidity.
stories.whyItMatters: Bond market stress and liquidity support shape the rate environment that influences flows into crypto and other risk assets.
whatToWatch: Future Treasury buyback operations
Further dealer commentary on bond market liquidity
questions: What size of buyback would dealers consider adequate?

sources.title: Treasury bought back $6B in bonds, but dealers say bigger isn’t enough

stories.title: South Korea Weighs Another Delay to Its 22% Crypto Tax
stories.summary: South Korea is considering another delay to its planned 22% crypto tax, CryptoSlate reports. A new provision would also let investors offset losses. This would mark a repeated postponement of the long-pending tax.
stories.whyItMatters: Tax treatment shapes retail and institutional participation in one of the world's most active crypto trading markets.
whatToWatch: A legislative decision on the delay
Details of the proposed loss-offset rule
questions: How many times has this tax now been postponed?
When would it take effect if delayed again?

sources.title: South Korea wants to delay its 22% crypto tax again and give investors a new break on losses
